_help.about: Facts the legal pages depend on that nothing in the code can confirm. Josh fills these in. node scripts/check-legal-pages.mjs --publish fails while any value below is null.
_help.legalEntity: Exact legal name and entity type as shown on the Apple seller record and the Google Play developer account, for example "Integrity Quality Solutions LLC". Every legal page, the site footer (site/assets/shared.js) and /terms/ must then use this exact string.
_help.counselReviewedOn: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) counsel approved /privacy/, /subprocessors/ and /delete-account/, including the processor position, the Play Data safety answer and each commitment flagged in the pages.
_help.deletionProcessLive: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or link showing that an in-app deletion request reaches privacy@iqsflow.com (or a queue IQS monitors), that a written deletion runbook exists matching /delete-account/, that counsel approved how the append-only audit history keeps a deleted person's details (or that audit entries no longer store them), and that the runbook and counsel settled work orders: deleting one writes a permanent copy to the append-only work_order_deletions table, and a real emergency report cannot be deleted except with the whole employer account (iqs-flow-api migration 20260928150000_next_batch).
_help.appVersionWithGates: App version on every phone that has the scheduled-shift gate on the 3-minute location check-in, the Delete my account option, deletion text that promises completed deletion within 30 days, and a location notice that says who can see your location (your supervisor, coworkers, and your employer's clients at their own sites), for example "1.1.0". Run the check with --publish --app-locales=<that release's locales folder>.
